info.title: AI Agent Supervisor API
info.description: Monitor, intervene in and configure AI customer-service agents. Real-time events are pushed over a WebSocket at ws://localhost:8080 (see the "WebSocket" tag).

tags.name: WebSocket
tags.description: Server → client: connection, ping, conversations_update, new_conversation, message_update, metrics_update, conversation_updated, alert, activity, agent_update, analytics_update, template_created|updated|deleted, preset_created|deleted, system_update. Client → server: subscribe {channel, parameters: {agentId}}, pong.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search customer name, case number, tag or issue

get.summary: Get one conversation (with live risk assessment)

put.summary: Save supervisor feedback on the agent (notes + rating)

post.summary: Record approve / escalate decision on the recommendation
Take over a conversation from the AI
Return control to the AI with guidance notes

409.description: Already released — guarded on the active state, no duplicate handoff note

patch.summary: Update configuration (optionally deploy as a governed change request)

changeRequest.description: When present and fields changed: bumps version, records CR, snapshots previous config

get.summary: Containment, CSAT, fallback and hallucination with deltas

post.summary: Run the evaluation suite (live config, or a draft in the body)
Replay a scenario in the simulation console
Apply a preset directly to an agent
Create a template (variables are detected from {{placeholders}})
Substitute variables (from a conversation and/or explicit values)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events: dashboard metrics every 2 seconds (event: metrics)
get.description: text/event-stream. Each `metrics` event carries kpis, series, queueHealth, signals and scope for the given range/region. Consume with EventSource; the browser reconnects automatically (retry: 3000).

get.summary: Global search across conversations, agents and templates

content.description: Plain text or sanitized HTML with {{variable}} placeholders
